# relay

> An open-source harness that turns one person's coding-agent subscriptions (Claude, Codex, Grok) into one system: GitHub issues as the task bus, workers on your own machines (`relay work`) that claim and run them, shared memory in Postgres, and an event feed of everything agents did. Credentials never leave the machine they were created on.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): what it does, quick install, how to link model accounts
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): instructions for coding agents working in or installing this repo
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): the design and the rules behind it

## Guides

- [Workers](docs/WORKERS.md): how a machine becomes a worker with `relay work`: lanes from logins, the claim and lease protocol, what a job does, the service files, cloud lanes
- [Runners](docs/RUNNERS.md): advanced and optional: self-hosted GitHub Actions runners, and the cloud lanes' vendor setup and limits
- [Hosting](docs/HOSTING.md): deploying the web app on Vercel with Neon Postgres and Blob
- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): the credential rule, prompt-injection posture, what is never allowed
- [Memory](docs/MEMORY.md): decisions, preferences, vendor guidance, the brief compiler, the CLI hooks, and the `relay_*` MCP tools
- [Assets](docs/ASSETS.md): private media storage with an approve-or-reject review loop
- [Feed](docs/FEED.md): event kinds, sources, the ledger view, and the outbound webhook contract (payload, signature)
- [Integrations](docs/INTEGRATIONS.md): what an external bot needs: a scoped token, the task and event tools, the webhook, and a Grok Bot walkthrough
- [Agent readiness](docs/AGENT-READINESS.md): what the hosted site serves so agents can find, read, and use it
- [Versioning](docs/VERSIONING.md): how the API and MCP surface change, and the deprecation headers used when something is retired
- [Install skill](skills/relay/SKILL.md): the agent skill for installing and operating relay
